meta.description: Grid carbon intensity used for operational emissions when a tool does not state its own. India runs a single synchronised national grid, so one national figure is used; there is no defensible state-wise split of grid carbon, unlike tariffs.

rows.basis: Weighted average emission factor adjusted for renewable energy, FY 2023-24
rows.scope: CO2 only; excludes methane, nitrous oxide, transmission and distribution losses and upstream fuel emissions
rows.verification: Figure read from secondary summaries of the CEA database (Saur Energy and Climatiq); the CEA workbook itself was not opened. Check the primary before relying on it.
